overall_summary: Data volume is low with wide variance. Content centered around husband-wife relationship dynamics ('रिश्ते', 'अकेलापन') significantly outperforms family member tropes and pure sad poetry in early sample traction.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'or5gtaBpRVY' (1,674 views) and 'my5mP9feI7s' (1,766 views) outperformed standard poetry/family content by 5x-10x.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marital and modern relationship realities instead of generic sad shayaris.

weak_patterns.evidence: Video 'YdWh4cDOE64' got only 14 views because abstract sad phrasing fails to grip the audience quickly in Shorts feeds.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid high-abstract poetry openers; ground the emotion in concrete domestic actions.

next_video.hook_style: Observation on unspoken distance between partners
next_video.concept: A couple sitting in complete silence in the same room, scrolling phones, realizing they know everything about their digital feeds but nothing about each other's current day.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with the sound of tapping screens and a close-up of a cup of tea getting cold between two people.
next_video.twist_direction: Reveal that silence isn't peace anymore; it's two strangers sharing the same address.
